body:
P4-24 DRAWN, not built (drawing PR only: the rule is that no screen is coded before its drawing exists, and the Data saver switch was not drawn anywhere).

What is drawn (docs/design/directions/screens-first-run-and-settings.html, S-72, classes C and X; inventory row S-72 updated): Playback gets ONE switch line directly under the two quality rows ("Data saver": "Uses less mobile data: lower quality, smaller pictures, less loaded ahead. Never on Wi-Fi."). States: off; on while the phone is on Wi-Fi (grey note "Only used on mobile data."); on while the phone is on mobile data (green note "Data saver is working." + what changes; the "On mobile data" quality row keeps the person's choice and says "Data saver is limiting this to Opus 48 kbps right now."; the C frame's status bar shows 4G); and Downloads and storage while it is in force (the Quality line says it limits new downloads; "Download over Wi-Fi only" drawn off, because while it is on nothing downloads on mobile data at all).

The meaning as decided (note of 14 Nov): the switch is a CAP, never a second quality choice: the person's own "On mobile data" choice is never overwritten and comes back when the switch goes off. One stored setting + one derived value "Data saver is in force" (switch on AND phone on mobile data), read by the four consumers (streaming quality, new downloads, pictures, prepare-ahead); none asks the network on its own.

WHICH HALF IS WHOSE: three effects are behind this switch (quality, small pictures, only the next song prepared). Syncing less is P1-14's (Less syncing; B-81 poke no-op while the channel is live, the 6 h library pass gap on mobile data): it is always on and behind no switch, so the acceptance clause "the idle sync moves less than before" is P1-14's, not P4-24's (task text edited to say so).

OPEN QUESTIONS for the code step (not decided in the drawing): (1) A song downloaded at 48 kbps on mobile data: does it stay at 48 kbps when the phone is back on Wi-Fi, or is it fetched again at the person's own quality? The decision says "caps new downloads" and is silent here. (2) X (browser/wide) frames show the same line; a client that cannot tell metered from unmetered would not show it: say so if the lead agrees.

Also for the code step: Wi-Fi-only downloads already exists (default on; Settings > Downloads & storage) and gets a test, not a rebuild; settings search keywords "data saver", "mobile data", "metered" must find Playback; the state-table rows (docs/33 PB-2, the cover rule) are updated in the code PR.
